title: Map Studio RPC catalogue: shared definitions
description: The one typed request list of the studio core (devdocs/map_studio/S5_BROWSER_EDITOR.md 2.3). Each <group>.rpc.json names its methods under `methods`; a method's full name is <group>.<name>. The same list is served by `oymap serve` (JSON-RPC 2.0, one message a line), by `oymap call <method> <json>` and by the WebAssembly core's `oymap_call(method, json)`. Rules: (1) params and results are closed objects (additionalProperties false) except trees marked x-tree; (2) every non-integer number in a result carries x-decimals, the core rounds it to that many decimals, and world positions are integers; (3) a method either does what was asked and returns its result, or returns a typed error whose data.kind names the reason; (4) results never carry absolute paths: files are named relative to the project; (5) adding a method, an optional parameter, a result field or an error kind keeps x-rpc-version; anything else raises it.

x-error-codes.-32600: the message is not a JSON-RPC request
x-error-codes.-32602: the params do not match the method's schema (data.kind invalid_params)
x-error-codes.-32000: the method understood the request and refused it (every other data.kind)

project_path.description: A project folder. The host maps what a browser may name onto folders it allows (the path jail); the core takes the folder as given.

revision.description: The project's source revision: a 128-bit content hash (the first 32 hex digits of a SHA-256) of the canonical text of its source files (project, plan, sketch, rooms, objects, wiring, atmosphere), the same for any two readers. Pins and the id lock do not change it (S5_BROWSER_EDITOR.md 2.4.1). Opaque: compare for equality only.

lock_hash.description: The id lock's hash (the first 32 hex digits of a SHA-256 of ids.lock.yml), or none when the project has no lock. A build is its source revision plus its lock hash.

file_name.description: A project file, relative to the project folder.

object_id.description: A readable id of a project object, <kind>:<name> (room:hall, door:gate).

file_tree.description: A project file's parsed content as JSON, maps in file order; its shape is the file's own schema (oymap schema <file>). Numbers are as written in the file.

file_trees.description: Project files by name, each with its parsed tree.

severity.description: error: the map cannot be built as written (stops a build); warning: it builds, but a rule is broken; note: for information. Today every issue is an error except the outdoor sketch's findings on heights and coverage, which the build takes as warnings.

issue.description: One problem found in a project.

code.description: The kind of problem, stable for tools: project, yaml, schema, reference, geometry, ...

file.description: The file, relative to the project; empty when the problem is the project as a whole.

path.description: Where in the file, as rooms[3].floor; empty for the whole file.

fixes.description: check.validate: what the core can do about it, each a transaction for edit.apply (S5_BROWSER_EDITOR.md 3.10: "a fix where the core offers one as operations"): a reference to a missing id taken out or dropped (or the object that cannot stand without it removed), a word on the wrong kind dropped, an undeclared map variable declared, the party start set.

point3i.description: A position [x, y, z] in world units, rounded to integers.

map_target.description: A shipped map's file name (6d01.blv, oute3.odm; with `world`), or a project folder, built into a private folder and read as the game would read it (an overlay project: its base map with the overlay in front). The host maps a browser's project keys; shipped maps are named by file name only.

error.description: The JSON-RPC error object of every method.

message.description: For people and agents; not for parsing.

invalid_params.description: The params do not match the method's schema (code -32602).

path.description: Where in the params, as ops[0].value.

not_a_project.description: The folder is missing or holds no readable project.yml.

no_such_file.description: The project has no such file.

locked.description: Another process is writing the project (.oymap/lock); call again.

stale_revision.description: The project is no longer at expect_revision. Read it again and send the operations against the new revision.

since.description: What changed outside the tool since the core last saw the project, when it was found by this call.

bad_operation.description: An operation could not be applied; nothing was written.

step.description: For a patch: the step's place in its patch.

new_errors.description: The change would add issues of severity error; nothing was written (allow_errors writes it anyway).

revision_after.description: The revision the project would have had.

has_errors.description: The project has issues of severity error, so it does not build.

no_such_pin.description: The project has no pin of that id.

wrong_state.description: The pin is not in a state the action applies to (claiming a resolved pin, accepting an open one, a pin another agent holds).

bad_request.description: The request cannot be done as asked: an `on` the project lacks, an empty text, a missing inbox folder. The message says what to change.

no_asset_root.description: The method reads an asset root and the session has none that opens.

no_such_object.description: Nothing in the project (or the map) has that id, list or event number.

no_such_map.description: The asset root (with the mount, when asked) has no map of that name in that world.

nothing_to_undo.description: No change is left to undo (or to redo).

no_mount.description: The method installs into or reads the session's mount of builds, and the session has none (session.configure, serve --mount).

failed.description: The core failed; the message says how (code -32603).
